note: Streams camera frames and prints the image size and the frame rate (%5.2f) per frame, from a process that needs KKERN_SZ_STACK_LL under newlib: with KKERN_SZ_STACK_MM it panicked with 'process stack underflow detected!' before its first line on Asmodee_H747 (A/B, 2026-11-09). The first rate is low (the camera starting); the row asks for later ones above 1 fps. It cannot run on the bench Discovery_U5G9, which has no SRAM6 for application data.
